name: v5.6.0
body:
## Scorecard Infrastructure Migration

v5.6.0 is the first Scorecard release since our hosted services moved! :tada:

The weekly batch scans and the REST API now run on [AboutCode Foundation](https://aboutcode.org)
infrastructure on AWS, operated in partnership with the Scorecard Steering Committee.

AboutCode is a public-benefit non-profit that already consumes Scorecard data and runs similar
large-scale data services, including [PurlDB](https://purldb.io) and
[VulnerableCode](https://public.vulnerablecode.io).

The full announcement is in [#5208](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5208).

What this means for you:

- **CLI and REST API users:** nothing changes. The API endpoint and the tooling are the same.
- **Scorecard Action users:** Upgrade to
  [v2.5.0](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-action/releases/tag/v2.5.0) or later. Older versions
  pull images from `gcr.io`, which has been retired, and will fail.
- **Container images:** use `ghcr.io/ossf/scorecard`. Existing version tags were copied from
  `gcr.io/openssf/scorecard` with identical digests (v5.5.0 was already published to GHCR), so only
  the registry and namespace change:

  ```diff
  - gcr.io/openssf/scorecard:<tag>@sha256:<sha>
  + ghcr.io/ossf/scorecard:<tag>@sha256:<sha>
  ```

- **BigQuery dataset users:** the public dataset is no longer available.
- **Weekly scan inventory:** to add a repository to the weekly scans, follow
  [`ossf/scorecard-infra`'s contributing guide](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-infra/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
  The pipeline and its project lists moved there.
- **Allstar users:** the hosted Allstar GitHub App has been retired. Allstar continues as a
  Scorecard subproject; see the [Allstar README](https://github.com/ossf/allstar) for self-hosting.

Report infrastructure problems at [ossf/scorecard-infra](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-infra/issues).

Thank you to AboutCode Foundation for giving Scorecard a new home, and to everyone who reported
migration issues and helped other projects update.

## Action Required

- **Workflow checks now read YAML aliases, so Pinned-Dependencies may report more findings.** Steps
  reached through an alias (`uses: *anchor`, aliased `run:`) were previously skipped and are now
  checked by Pinned-Dependencies, Dangerous-Workflow and the other workflow-based checks. Each
  aliased step counts, so a repository that reuses unpinned actions this way and wasn't already at 0
  can lose score. by @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5287
- **Library users: `checks/fileparser` signatures changed.** Exported workflow helpers
  (`GetJobName`, `AnyJobsMatch`, `IsPackagingWorkflow` and others) now take Scorecard's own workflow
  types instead of `github.com/rhysd/actionlint` types, and some workflow parse error messages are
  worded differently. by @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5287
- **Library users: `cron/` has been removed.** `cron/data` and `cron/config` are no longer
  importable; the batch-scan pipeline now lives in `ossf/scorecard-infra` (see Scorecard
  Infrastructure Migration). by @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5210
- **Library users: Go 1.26.5 or later is required** (`go` directive raised from 1.26.0). by
  @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5296

## General

- Release container images are built with Go 1.27.2. by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5310
- `--format=intoto` output is now serialized with `protojson`, so field names match the in-toto
  specification. by @puerco in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5225
- On Windows, file paths from GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps repositories now use forward slashes,
  matching other platforms. by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5153

### Azure DevOps

- Legacy Azure DevOps repository URLs are accepted and normalized to `dev.azure.com`. by @JamieMagee
  in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5128
- No workflow runs are returned, without querying every build, when the requested YAML pipeline
  doesn't exist. by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5129
- Language-aware checks fall back to all supported languages when language analytics are
  unavailable. by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5130
- A repository file larger than the archive extraction limit is now rejected instead of silently
  truncated. by @Sahana2524 in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5173

## Checks

### Packaging

- ko publishing workflows are detected with either `imjasonh/setup-ko` or `ko-build/setup-ko`;
  previously the matcher never fired. by @arcaven in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5134

### Pinned-Dependencies

- Actions referenced from the same repository with GitHub's `$/` prefix (for example `uses:
  $/.github/actions/example`) are treated like `./` local actions and no longer reported as
  unpinned. by @trask with @Kielek in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5191

### Vulnerabilities

- Python requirements files no longer trigger transitive dependency resolution, which could stall
  the check until it timed out. For library users, `clients.ExperimentalLocalOSVClient` no longer
  makes network requests for transitive resolution. osv-scanner is updated to v2.5.1. by
  @justaugustus with @adilalperenciftci in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5296
- Maven dependencies whose version is an unresolved build placeholder (for example
  `@project.version@` or `${revision}`) are no longer reported. by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5306

### Probes

- The `unsafeblock` probe also detects Java's `sun.misc.Unsafe` and `jdk.internal.misc.Unsafe`
  classes. by @thomasleplus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4849

## Docs

- :book: Set GitLab support for Code-Review and Dependency-Update-Tool by @dvcorreia in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4963
- 📖 docs: clarify partial credit logic for Branch-Protection tiers by @aban-alazzeh in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5010
- :book: Validate Security Insights in CI (and fix the schema) by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5298

## Other

- 🌱 ci: use ginkgo --flake-attempts instead of nick-invision/retry for e2e tests by @alliasgher in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5013
- :seedling: update e2e test to account for new vulns by @spencerschrock in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5159
- :seedling: deps: Upgrade golang.org/x/crypto v0.50.0 => v0.56.0 by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5223
- :seedling: e2e/fuzz: Account for Scorecard API repo migration by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5253
- :seedling: workflows/stale: Stop closing stale pull requests by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5259
- :seedling: dependabot: Add/fix broken `exclude-patterns` in gomod group by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5260
- :seedling: dependabot: Exclude `moby/buildkit` and `goreleaser` from grouped updates by
  @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5263
- :seedling: dependabot: Exclude `google/ko` and `go-git` from grouped updates by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5269
- :seedling: go.mod: Bump go-git, containerd, sigstore-go, slack-go, go-pkcs12 by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5271
- :seedling: Bump github.com/prometheus/prometheus to v0.311.3 by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5294
- :seedling: Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.58.0 to 0.60.0 by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5311
- :seedling: Bump GoReleaser to v2.18.3 and pin it for releases by @dependabot[bot] in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5309

## Known Issues

- **GitLab: Vulnerabilities returns −1** for every GitLab repository
  ([#5056](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5056)). A fix is planned for v5.7.0
  ([#5180](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5180)).
- **Vulnerabilities: npm bundled dependencies are not checked.** Since the osv-scanner update,
  `package-lock.json` entries without a `resolved` URL, which includes bundled dependencies, are
  skipped when matching known vulnerabilities. This comes from osv-scalibr; we're following up
  upstream.
- **Pinned-Dependencies: findings reached through a YAML alias point at the anchor's line**, not the
  alias. How aliased steps are counted and attributed is tracked in
  [#5291](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5291).

## What's Changed

## General
* :bug: Scorecard now skips dangling symlinks and detects symlink path traversal when run on local files. Note: Scorecard has always skipped all symlinks when run against a remote repository. (#4785, @spencerschrock)
* :sparkles: The `scorecard serve` command was refactored and fixed. It accepts HTTP requests, analyzes the repo, and returns the result over HTTP. by @Fix3dP0int in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4665
```
scorecard serve # will start serving on localhost:8080
curl http://localhost:8080?repo=github.com/ossf/scorecard&show_details=true
{"date":"2025-09-30T09:08:38-06:00","repo":{"name":"github.com/ossf/scorecard","commit":"c22063e786c11f9dd714d777a687ff7c4599b600"},"scorecard":{"version":"devel","commit":"unknown"},"score":9.5 # rest omitted
```

## Checks

### Branch-Protection
* :bug: Prevent ListReleases from failing a run for forges which don't support the operation (#4677, @JamieMagee)
* :bug: Skip tag-only rulesets during Branch-Protection by @trask in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4699

### Contributors
* :bug: Fixed a nil pointer dereference in the Contributors check for GitHub repos analyzed with `--file-mode=git` (#4705, @spencerschrock)

### Pinned-Dependencies

# What's Changed

  * The default method if unspecified is `--file-mode archive` which is what older versions of Scorecard always used.
  * `--file-mode git` produces the most accurate results for repositories with `.gitattributes` files at the cost of analysis speed. This currently only supports GitHub but can be expanded to other forges in the future.
* The Scorecard binary name in releases is now consistent across all platforms (#4520, @timothysparg)
* Scorecard now prints a warning if multiple GitHub PAT environment variables are set with different values. (#4483, @aunovis-heidrich)

## Azure DevOps Support (Experimental)
There is now experimental support for Azure DevOps repositories (thanks @JamieMagee). Most checks should work, but the following checks do not: `Branch-Protection`,  `SBOM`, and `Signed-Releases`.

To analyze a repository:
1. Set the `SCORECARD_EXPERIMENTAL` environment variable to any value.
2. Put your access token in the `AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_TOKEN` environment variable.

name: v5.0.0
body:
# What's Changed

We’ll highlight the major changes between `v4.13.1` and `v5.0.0` below, as well as some of the changes between `v5.0.0-rc2` and `v5.0.0`. For a more complete picture, see the [v5.0.0-rc1](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/releases/tag/v5.0.0-rc1) and [v5.0.0-rc2](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/releases/tag/v5.0.0-rc2) changelogs as well.

## Structured Results

Structured Results is the main feature from this release. At a high level, structured results involve breaking the existing 19 Scorecard Checks into individual heuristics so users can pick and choose which ones they care about. You can see a list of all supported probes by checking out our [documentation](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/docs/probes.md) (paying attention to [lifecycle / stability guarantees](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/probes/README.md#lifecycle)). To run individual probes, use the `--probes` CLI flag with a comma separated list of names. You must also specify the `--format probe` option to see the results. Please run `scorecard --help` if you need more details.
Example:
```shell
scorecard --repo github.com/ossf/scorecard --probes archived,fuzzed,hasLicenseFile --format probe
```

For more details on the feature, please check out our [blog post](https://openssf.org/blog/2024/04/17/beyond-scores-with-openssf-scorecard-granular-structured-results-for-custom-policy-enforcement/) or the talk given at Open Source Summit NA 2024: [Structured Scorecard Results: Tailor Your Own Supply-Chain Security Policies](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZT3XdMF6U5A).


## Maintainer Annotations

Maintainer Annotations let maintainers add context to display alongside Scorecard check results. Annotations can provide users additional information when Scorecard has an incomplete assessment of a project's security practices. To see the maintainers annotations for each check, if present, use the `--show-annotations` option. For example, the `not-detected` annotation can annotate when a maintainer fulfills a check or probe in a way that is supported by Scorecard but not identified.


For more details, check out our [documentation](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/config/README.md) for the feature.

## Breaking Changes

### API changes

The biggest change is that everything in [github.com/ossf/scorecard/v4/pkg](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ossf/scorecard/v4/pkg) now lives in [github.com/ossf/scorecard/v5/pkg/scorecard](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ossf/scorecard/v5/pkg/scorecard). This allows renaming of some function names and types to be less repetitive.
* `RunScorecard` is now `Run`
* `ScorecardResult` is now `Result`

Expected changes:
```
pkg.ScorecardRun() -> scorecard.Run()
pkg.ScorecardResult -> scorecard.Result
```

The signature of `RunScorecard` (now called `Run`) has changed to allow for fewer breaking changes in the future. For full motivation, see the [associated issue](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/3717). There should be fewer setup code needed than before. Callers no longer need to pass in all clients and arguments and can rely on sensible default behavior. Callers that want to customize the analysis can influence the results with our Option types.


A [similar change](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4151) was done with formatting the results, which now accept an option struct pointer. Using a nil pointer will use default values.


### Unlikely to cause issues

These changes are technically breaking in a semver sense, but we don’t expect most users to depend on them or require changes.

* Dependency diff functionality has been removed in #4146. 
  * For GitHub replacements, consider [actions/dependency-review-action](https://github.com/actions/dependency-review-action) which now supports showing Scorecard data. 
* `clients.Repo` must now implement Path in #4104
* `clients.RepoClient` now returns a read closer in #3912
* Some branch protection types were renamed in #3879
* Some sentinel errors were renamed in #4040

## Checks
### Binary-Artifacts
* Binary-Artifacts check now supports the new gradle wrapper validation action, and can be pinned to a hash. (#4097, @spencerschrock)

### Dependency-Update-Tool
* :sparkles: Recognize scala-steward as dependency update tool by @raboof in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4130


### Fuzzing

### Packaging

### Pinned-Dependencies
* Improve Pinned-Dependencies remediation creation performance (#4131, @raboof)

### SBOM

### Vulnerabilities

## Probes

## Description
This release of Scorecard provides bug fixes, enhancements and new features and many other changes. The project remains available via a [docker image](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/tree/v4.0.0#docker).

## Release Notes

### New code features and enhancements

- Improved parsing of GitHub workflows
- Improved test coverage
- Scaled weekly cron job repos to analyze ~1M projects

- Weekly scans for ~1M GitHub repos with critical ecosystems dependencies from [deps.dev](https://deps.dev).

body:
## Description
This release of Scorecard provides bug fixes, enhancements and new features, including many changes that are not compatible with earlier versions of Scorecard. The project remains available via a [docker image](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/tree/v3.0.0#docker).

## Release Notes

### API changes
We are experimenting with new APIs based on user feedback to improve clarity and usability. Please try them out and leave us feedback on the scorecard repository!

### New code features and enhancements
- Numeric scoring and risk categories replace Pass/Fail.
- Aggregated score.
- [Improved JSON](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/pkg/json.v2.schema) output (`--format json | jq`).
- New [repo interface](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/clients/repo_client.go) to simplify the future integration of other code versioning systems besides GitHub.
- Use GitHub v4 (GraphQL) APIs instead of REST API to improve performance and efficiency. 
- Improved documentation ([checks](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/docs/checks.md) and main [README](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/README.md)).
### Removal
- Support for CSV format has been removed. Please use the [JSON format](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/pkg/json.v2.schema) to upgrade.

### Scaling
- Weekly scans for 200k GitHub repos with critical ecosystems dependencies from [deps.dev](https://deps.dev).
- Weekly scan results are available in a [BigQuery table](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/tree/v3.0.0#public-data) in the [new JSON format](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/cron/format/json.v2.schema).

### LTS
- Weekly scans that output the older JSON format will continue until 31 March 2022. 
- Weekly scans that output the [new JSON format](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/v3.0.0/cron/format/json.v2.schema) will be available at least until the end of 2022.

### Huge thanks to all community contributors

# Scorecard v1.1.1 release notes



Changes since v1.1.0
---
- The scorecard releases are signed with gpg keys :key: 
- Scorecard adds `json` response to the `http` endpoints.
- This release included scanning of `2000` additional GitHub repositories.
- The docker image of scorecard is published at GitHub Docker registry.
- The dependent libaries were upgraded  github.com/spf13/cobra from `1.1.1` to `1.1.2`  and github.com/spf13/cobra from `1.1.2` to `1.1.3`
- There were improvements to the e2e testing.
- The minor bug fixes to the existing scans.


_Thanks to all our contributors!_ 😊
